channel.description: This is a randomly ordered feed of the most recent entries from summarizedStoriesMainNLbreakingNews, skipping any feeds with errors.

item.title: DOJ asks California to review noncitizen mail ballot list
item.description: The Justice Department has directed California to review a list of individuals the federal government believes may have received mail-in ballots.

item.title: Police search home after double homicide at resort
item.description: Metallica Rose Harrison was charged with two counts of homicide after her husband and 3-year-old son were found dead with stab wounds.

item.title: Houthis attack Saudi capital as Trump weighs strikes
item.description: Iran's Houthi allies launched a new attack on Saudi Arabia and promised more as Trump considers U.S. action on a new front line.

item.title: Russia launches massive attack on Ukraine with hundreds of drones
item.description: Kyiv said Moscow has chosen to deliberately escalate its attacks.
